title: Accounts Assistant
description:
An established manufacturing business located in Bognor Regis, West Sussex is seeking a dedicated Accounts Assistant to support their finance team. With a history dating back to 1971 and an annual turnover of £7 million, this organisation offers a stable and professional environment with growth aspirations.

The role provides an opportunity to utilise broad accounting experience within a friendly, team-oriented culture. The role is offered on a part-time basis of between 12 to 15 hours per week depending on the successful candidate's preference with Tuesday and Friday being compulsory days. This role is a temporary to permanent opportunity.

What will the Accounts Assistant role involve?
- Supporting the finance team with sales and purchase ledger activities to ensure smooth financial operations
- Assisting with bank reconciliations and maintaining accurate cashbook records
- Processing invoices, payments, and credit notes across multiple currencies (GBP, EUR, USD)
- Contributing to month-end reporting and VAT submissions
- Responding to sales and customer enquiries, supporting administrative tasks to maintain efficient operations

Suitable Candidate for the Accounts Assistant vacancy:
- Experience with Pegasus Opera 3 or comparable accounting software is advantageous
- Strong MS Excel skills with an eye for detail
- Positive attitude, adaptable approach, and ability to work collaboratively
- Prior experience in manufacturing or retail environments is desirable
- Ability to handle multiple tasks concurrently and demonstrate a proactive approach

Additional benefits and information for the role of Accounts Assistant:
- 1pm finish on a Friday
- Free parking
- 25 days holiday + BH (pro rata for part-time hours)
- Life Assurance
- Salary will be dependent on experience

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
- Accounts Assistant - Part Time
- Location: Eastbourne
- Hours: 12 hours per week - Tuesdays and Fridays (Flexible for the right candidate)
- Salary: £31,000 pro rata
- Job Type: Permanent

About the role

HRGO Recruitment are looking for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join our client, a leading UK-based online auction company with an innovative and fast-paced approach to its work.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous accounts and credit control experience who enjoys variety, takes ownership of their work and is confident working independently.

Working just two days a week, you'll play an important role in keeping the day-to-day finance function running smoothly, supporting everything from invoicing and payments to credit control and supplier management.

What you'll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:
- Reconciling and processing purchase invoices, receipts, merchant payments and direct debits
- Processing weekly sales invoices
- Managing credit control, including contacting clients by phone and email
- Managing the accounts and suppliers' inboxes
- Creating weekly payment runs
- Supporting customer onboarding and offboarding
- Processing monthly supplier invoicing
- Assisting with payroll and pension queries
- Carrying out quarterly audits of management accounts, standing orders, purchase invoices and nominal codes
- Providing general support across the accounts function as required

About you

We're looking for someone who:
- Has previous experience in an accounts or finance role
- Has experience in credit control
- Is confident working independently and managing their own workload
- Is organised, accurate and comfortable working to deadlines
- Has a good eye for detail and takes pride in getting things right
- Is confident communicating with customers, suppliers and colleagues
- Has experience using accounting software - ideally Xero, Sage and Zendesk

Benefits
- 28 days holiday (Pro rata for part time roles)
- Convenient town centre office with excellent access to train links
- Active and inclusive social committee
- On-site games room stocked with complimentary snacks and drinks
- Relaxed, casual dress code
- Supportive and welcoming team environment
- Bright, modern, and open-plan workspaces

If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please click 'APPLY NOW' and a consultant from our Eastbourne team will be in contact.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant
Uckfield
32,000- 35,000 per annum
Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm
January 2027 start
We're recruiting for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join an established and growing business within the construction sector. Working as part of a small finance team, you'll play an important role in the day-to-day running of the accounts function, supporting accurate and timely financial processing.
This is a varied, hands-on position suited to someone who is organised, proactive and happy to get stuck in wherever needed to help the team meet deadlines.
Key Responsibilities
- Process purchase ledger invoices, matching them to purchase orders and liaising with suppliers for supporting documentation
- Process weekly subcontractor payments and manage CIS payments
- Support weekly payroll processing for site operatives
- Complete month-end reconciliations and assist with general accounting duties

- Manage a shared finance mailbox, responding to queries and following up outstanding information
- Maintain accurate financial records using internal databases and online systems
- Provide cover for colleagues and support additional finance tasks as required
Candidate Profile
- Previous experience in an accounts or finance role
- Essential experience processing CIS payments
- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with online systems and databases
- Good numerical ability, accuracy and excellent attention to detail
- Well-organised, self-motivated and able to manage competing priorities
- A positive, flexible attitude with a willingness to support colleagues and take the initiative
- Professional communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a small team
- AAT Level 2 or 3 qualified or studying towards or relevant accounting degree
Benefits
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
- Company pension contributions
- Discretionary annual bonus
- Christmas shutdown
- Optional membership of a company healthcare scheme
- Ongoing training and support to continue your accountancy qualifications
- Regular staff training and social events
